articles.title: Investigation Launched After Fire at Illegal Waste Site in Rochdale
articles.excerpt: The Environment Agency has confirmed an investigation into a fire at an illegal waste site in Smallbridge, which required extensive firefighting efforts over the weekend.
articles.content_html:
An investigation has been launched following a fire at a waste site in Smallbridge. Crews worked throughout the night on Friday, July 24, after a fire broke out off Spring Mill Walk. Thick plumes of smoke were visible for miles around, prompting a significant response from emergency services.

Firefighters were called to the scene at 8.15pm and worked until around 1pm the following day to extinguish the fire. Six fire engines and specialist equipment were deployed to tackle the blaze, which involved a large quantity of waste at the site.

The Environment Agency became involved due to the nature of the incident and confirmed that the fire occurred at an illegal waste site. An update issued on August 1 stated that the site is now under investigation following the incident.

Residents in the surrounding area were advised to keep their windows and doors closed during the firefighting efforts to avoid smoke inhalation. The investigation will determine the circumstances surrounding the fire and the status of the site.
